A '''dead-reckoning program''', also referred to as a '''deadreckoner,''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] program that could be used in the absence of proper navigational instruments to make a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] travel on a pre-set course.<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
